Questions North Texas homeowners ask

The PDF did not open. What now?

Use the button on this page again, or right-click it and choose to save the link. The file is a standard PDF that opens in any browser or phone. You can come back to this page any time from the checklist page.

I gave my phone number. Who will call?

An independent roofing company that works in your ZIP code may call about looking at your roof. It is not the line calling, and you are under no obligation. Ask whether it charges to inspect, and ask for proof of insurance before anyone goes up on the roof. See how the line works.

Where can I learn more about hail claims in Texas?

The roof insurance claim guide explains percentage deductibles, actual cash value versus replacement cost, depreciation holdbacks and what Texas law lets a roofer do and not do during a claim.
